manual.assortedtools.chapter.staffs.fros:
The blaze rod's cold counterpart. Strays drop them as blazes drop theirs, and any other monster killed in a snowy biome sometimes does.

A frost rod grinds into frost powder, and frost powder, gunpowder and a snowball make ice charges.
manual.assortedtools.chapter.staffs.nept:
Switch its mode with the tool mode key, Z by default.

Place Water pours a water source where you click. Freeze Mobs freezes every mob around you solid, and Freeze Water turns the still water around you to ice.

It is no weapon, but anything it hits is frozen where it stands.
manual.assortedtools.chapter.staffs.phoe:
The Neptune staff's the opposite. Place Lava and Place Fire where you click, Thaw Mobs frees every frozen mob around you, and Melt Ice melts the ice around you.

A hit with it thaws a frozen mob.
manual.assortedtools.chapter.staffs.powe: Right click a block to push it one step away, or in a pull mode to drag it one step toward the side you clicked.
manual.assortedtools.description: Tool and armor sets for every material, buckets that hold more than one, throwing weapons and the wands that do the digging for you.
